sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "bridge"."architect_id" AS e, "architect"."gender" AS g, SUM("bridge"."length_feet") AS m1 FROM "bridge" JOIN "architect" ON "architect"."id" = "bridge"."architect_id"  GROUP BY "bridge"."architect_id", "architect"."gender"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: total of bridge length in feet per architect within architect.gender (additive)
share of the all total of total of bridge length in feet (all level)
rank within the group by total of bridge length in feet, keep the top 3
